scenes.title: Ember Gallery
scenes.question: Which exhibit triggered the first alarm?

scenes.title: Server Vault
scenes.question: Which account opened the maintenance log?

clues.text: Scorch marks ring the Solar Lantern pedestal.
Harbour camera shows the Tideless drifting unmoored.
Level 4 access log closes before the alarm sounds.
Badge NightOwl swiped the vault at 02:14.
The Meridian 12 cradle sits forty degrees off centre.

information.headline: Gallery night roster
information.detail: Two guards walked the west wing at 21:00 and reported nothing unusual.
information.answerSheet: West wing was clear at 21:00, so the gallery fault happened later.

information.headline: Power dip report
information.detail: A two second dip was logged on the north circuit at 01:52.
information.answerSheet: The dip at 01:52 is the earliest recorded electrical event.

information.headline: Case soot sample
information.detail: Waxy residue sits in a perfect ring around pedestal three.
information.answerSheet: Pedestal three was heat damaged, not struck by a tool.

information.headline: Glass fragment map
information.detail: Fragments lie inward from the case, so the impact came from inside.
information.answerSheet: The gallery damage was internal, ruling out a thrown object.

information.headline: Thermostat override
information.detail: Someone pushed the lantern override at 01:58 from a wall panel.
information.answerSheet: The override was used on purpose, not by a fault.

information.headline: Night porter statement
information.detail: The porter left the atrium at 00:40 and saw the doors latched.
information.answerSheet: Doors were latched, so entry used another route.

information.headline: Vault badge log
information.detail: One badge opened the vault door: NightOwl, at 02:14.
information.answerSheet: NightOwl is the only account recorded entering the vault.

information.headline: Server room temperature
information.detail: Rack five ran four degrees warm from 01:30 onward.
information.answerSheet: Rack five was the warm rack, but temperature alone is not a cause.

information.headline: Camera blind corner
information.detail: The archive corridor camera has been offline for eleven days.
information.answerSheet: The archive corridor has no usable footage for the night.

information.headline: Mooring assignment
information.detail: Four berths were staffed and one was left to the night shift.
information.answerSheet: The unstaffed berth belonged to the night shift.

information.headline: Harbour camera still
information.detail: A still frame shows the Tideless swinging free of its lines.
information.answerSheet: The Tideless lost its mooring lines, so it was unattended.

information.headline: Fuel reading
information.detail: The Tideless drew fuel at 01:45 with no crew logged aboard.
information.answerSheet: Fuel was taken while the boat was empty.

information.headline: Floor pressure sensors
information.detail: Level 4 held steady pressure while other floors dipped.
information.answerSheet: Level 4 was the calmest floor during the event.

information.headline: Cleaning cart log
information.detail: A cart was parked on Level 2 and never returned to the store.
information.answerSheet: The parked cart narrows the search to Level 2 and 4.

information.headline: Fire panel printout
information.detail: The panel triggered from a manual call point, zone seven.
information.answerSheet: Zone seven covers the atrium glass front.

information.headline: Lift usage
information.detail: The service lift ran empty from 02:00 to 02:20.
information.answerSheet: An empty service lift trip matches the cleared floor.

information.headline: Atrium access extract
information.detail: The Level 4 log ends at 01:59 and is never reopened.
information.answerSheet: Level 4 was cleared first, then the log was closed.

information.headline: Key register
information.detail: Two override keys are unaccounted for since the gala.
information.answerSheet: Missing keys explain how locked doors were opened.

information.headline: Sky clarity
information.detail: Cloudless conditions allowed full starlight for the deck.
information.answerSheet: Clear sky made the deck crew visible on the dome cam.

information.headline: Dome camera sweep
information.detail: The sweep found one open dome door and no forced entry.
information.answerSheet: The dome door was opened from inside the deck.

information.headline: Lens inventory
information.detail: Every lens tray is signed out except one.
information.answerSheet: Exactly one lens is unaccounted for.

information.headline: Cradle survey
information.detail: The Meridian 12 cradle sits forty degrees off its mount mark.
information.answerSheet: Meridian 12 was rotated, which matches a moved telescope.

information.headline: Dome temperature
information.detail: The dome cooled four degrees inside fifteen minutes.
information.answerSheet: The dome opened and lost air quickly.

information.headline: Suspect interview
information.detail: The suspect admits moving a telescope to see the harbour.
information.answerSheet: The motive links the deck to the harbour incident.

information.headline: Timeline summary
information.detail: Dip at 01:52, override at 01:58, vault at 02:14, then the alarm.
information.answerSheet: A single night links all five scenes in this order.
